sections.description: Narrow, logged abilities for Blue Collar Marketing's Claude workflows.
sections.changelog:
1.4.4

Hub requests keep WordPress's unfiltered_html capability, so Elementor no longer re-filters the whole page on each save: existing maps, iframes and form embeds survive edits made through the hub, and approved HTML embeds (calculators, form embeds) are saved exactly as approved instead of having their inputs and scripts stripped. New content is still refused by the content scan if it holds scripts, iframes or similar, and HTML embeds still need Chris's approval. The publish check no longer reports "Content is empty" for Elementor pages; clearer wording after unpublishing.

1.4.3

HTML embeds (bcm/add-html-embed) for form embeds and calculators, always behind Chris's second confirmation with the exact code. Pages as well as posts can be published, unpublished, made private (new bcm/make-private) or moved to the trash (new bcm/trash-post, optionally redirecting the old address); the homepage, blog and privacy pages are protected. Through the hub, on a launched site, a page going live (publish, a first publish through Elementor, or a publish status set through Elementor's page settings) and anything moved to the trash need Chris's second confirmation; blog posts go live (and schedule) with the person's confirmation alone, edits to pages that are already live are not held, and sites still on their Cloudways temporary address (*.cloudwaysapps.com) are treated as pre-launch, with none of these held. HTML embeds always need Chris. Redirects through the Redirection plugin (new bcm/list-redirects, bcm/add-redirect, bcm/remove-redirect), same-site only. Switching on Elementor's own tools (elementor/enable-elementor-abilities) no longer needs a Slack approval per site; Elementor still requires the person's consent.

1.4.2

New Set an image's alt text (bcm/update-image-alt). Swap an image no longer copies the old image's alt text onto the new one (it may show something else); it asks for a description instead. Find images reports the Media Library alt text for Atomic images.

1.4.1

Find images and Swap an image now see Atomic (V4) images placed from the Media Library by id, which is how Elementor's own build tools store them (no url saved); swaps keep Elementor's stored shape. List Media Library images now reads the library directly, so other plugins or snippets can't hide it (it came back empty on some sites), and its search matches file names and alt text as well as titles (e.g. "greyscale").

1.4.0

BCM Hub access: one signed endpoint that accepts only requests signed by the hub's key (5-minute window, single use, bound to this site) and runs allowed bcm/, elementor/ and yoast-seo/ abilities as an administrator without unfiltered HTML or plugin and user management; code widgets, scripts and custom CSS never allowed; tracking codes, form recipients, form submissions and site-wide settings need a second confirmation; on/off switch and acting user under Tools → BCM Activity Log; activity log shows "via hub" and who asked (anonymous ID). Nothing changes for the existing per-site connector.
